# Keep recovered details after saving and reloading

## What & Why
The keyboard recovery tests verify that optional fields are restored into the open form. Add coverage for the next user action so category, status, and priority cannot be lost when a recovered draft is saved and the page is reloaded.

## Done looks like
- Recover an answer with its category, save it, reload, and verify the category remains.
- Recover an opportunity with its status and priority, save it, reload, and verify both remain.
